items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: The Papa Salter's band was so far down one time, I worked with them. I worked with them for a while.

ctx.x: So he wanted to make sure that nobody messed him up on the money, huh? Mm-hmm. Was that a very common thing in those days, to work the doors like that? Who? That was a common thing that, uh, all over, even in New Orleans too?
Yeah, we call them PC, percentage. Yeah. We had a short name for it, PC. It was all in New Orleans. In New Orleans too? The Papa Salter's great band was doing that. They didn't make no money.
Did they make more money on working the door than they get a cash job?
